reason: Integrates with atuin to record user-typed dsh prompts in searchable local shell history, with filtering and truncation controls.

summaries.zh: 将用户在 dsh 中输入的提示词记录到 atuin 本地 shell 历史中，便于搜索并支持过滤和长度限制。
summaries.en: Records user-typed dsh prompts in atuin’s local shell history for searchable access with filtering and length limits.

capabilities: Reads user-typed prompts from session events
Invokes the local atuin CLI to start and end history entries
Writes recorded prompts to the local atuin history database
Supports deny patterns, truncation, and session filtering
